name: Pipeline target is not a managed environment
symptom: From October 2026 the admin deployment page notifies admins of deployments to a non-managed target and starts a 30-day countdown (one 30-day extension per environment); after it, deployments to that target are blocked. Before enforcement the deployment may succeed. Observe and record.
cause: Pipelines require all targets other than developer environments to be managed environments; enforcement starts October 2026.
fix: Enable Managed Environments on the target, or turn on automatic enablement under Power Platform admin center > Deployment > Settings; otherwise use the pac fallback without the pipeline governance.

name: Hotfix edited in the managed target
symptom: A change deployed from HLE-Dev does not appear in HLE-Test; solution layers show an Active unmanaged layer above the managed HLEHarbourlineOps layer.
cause: Edits in a target create unmanaged customizations in the unmanaged layer, which sits above all managed layers and wins at runtime; pipelines import as Upgrade without Overwrite customizations.
fix: Remove active customizations in the solution layers view; make all changes in HLE-Dev, bump the version and redeploy; give makers only Basic User in managed targets.

name: Unmanaged import into a downstream environment
symptom: pac import with --force-overwrite silently replaces changes; a later managed import of the same solution fails (observe and record the error); deleting the unmanaged solution leaves tables, flows, connector and agent behind.
cause: Unmanaged solutions share one unmanaged layer, can be overwritten on import and cannot be uninstalled as a unit; pipelines never deploy unmanaged solutions.
fix: Deploy only the managed export outside HLE-Dev; never use --force-overwrite downstream; load data with import-dataverse.ps1 only after the managed import; reset or delete polluted scratch environments.

name: Makers land in the default environment
symptom: A new agent created in Copilot Studio without choosing an environment lands in the tenant default environment, where all licensed users are makers. Environment routing shows Off.
cause: Environment routing is off by default; with no matching rule makers are routed to the default environment. Routing is premium, creates managed developer environments, and running assets there needs premium licenses.
fix: Power Platform admin center > Manage > Tenant settings > Environment routing (check Learn for the current label): choose portals, add a rule for a security group, pick an environment group. Scope carefully (3 developer environments per user, ENV-03).

name: Published agent waits for admin approval
symptom: Users keep getting the previous agent version, or do not find the agent under Built by your org; Copilot Studio or Agent Builder shows Waiting for approval; Microsoft 365 admin center Requests shows Pending review or Pending update; Graph returns requestStatus pending.
cause: Org-wide publishing creates a request that an AI Administrator must approve in the Microsoft 365 admin center; the previous version stays live until an update is approved; sharing is a separate path.
fix: Agents > All agents > Requests > Publish to store or Update in store (or Reject submission with a comment); monitor the pending queue daily; use sharing for pilots.

name: Environment-specific values travel with the solution
symptom: HLE-Test calls the developer's dev tunnel URL and fails when the tunnel stops; the pipeline prefills the value as coming from the solution; a connection reference without a connection leaves the flow off (observe and record).
cause: A current value of an environment variable included in the solution is exported and used in the next environment; connection references carry only the connector, not the connection.
fix: Remove the current value from the solution; generate one deployment settings file per stage with pac solution create-settings and fill values and connection IDs; refuse to import with empty values.

name: Personas cannot reach an agent in the developer environment
symptom: Security groups cannot be assigned to HLE-Dev; a persona cannot use the Dev copy of HLE Field Ops Assistant (observe and record the exact error).
cause: Developer environments are owner-only and cannot be assigned security groups.
fix: Test with personas in the HLE-Test sandbox and release from HLE-Prod; keep HLE-Dev for the maker only.
